questions.question: Why does a Vision Transformer use patches instead of feeding one pixel per token?
options: Pixel-per-token sequences explode attention compute quadratically and lose tractability at typical resolutions
Patches are required by PyTorch
Patches improve image quality
It avoids using a tokenizer
questions.explanation: A 224x224 image is 150528 pixel tokens. Attention is quadratic in length, so 16x16 patching shrinks the sequence to 196 tokens and makes the model tractable.

questions.question: What is the relationship between Conv2d with kernel = stride = patch_size and flatten-then-linear?
options: They produce different outputs
Conv2d is a faster way to spell the same linear projection over each patch
Conv2d adds non-linearity
Flatten-then-linear is impossible
questions.explanation: Each Conv2d output location dot-products the patch pixels with one filter, which is identical to flatten-then-linear.

questions.question: What makes sinusoidal_2d deterministic in this front end?
options: It copies a learned table from the previous image
It samples new offsets for each batch
It computes sin/cos values from grid coordinates and fixed frequencies; no position parameters are learned
It uses the random image seed as position data
questions.explanation: sinusoidal_2d builds the row and column values directly from arange coordinates and fixed frequency constants. Repeating the same grid and dimension therefore produces the same table without learned state.

questions.question: What is the output sequence length of a 224x224 image with patch_size=16 and one CLS token?
questions.explanation: 224/16 = 14, so 14x14 = 196 patches, plus one CLS token for 197 total tokens.

questions.question: Why is reconstruction (unfold then unflatten) a useful sanity check on the patch front end?
options: Round-tripping pixels through patch-flatten with no projection must equal the input; failure means the unfold math is wrong
It improves accuracy
It is required by ONNX
It speeds up inference
questions.explanation: The patch step is invertible without projection. If the round-trip drifts, the unfold logic is bugged and the rest of the encoder is unsafe.

questions.question: If you construct a second FrontEndConfig with image_size=256 and patch_size=16, what sequence length does its position table support?
options: 197, because the CLS token fixes the length
257: 16x16 patch positions plus the CLS row
256, because one token represents each image row
513: one patch token for every image pixel pair
questions.explanation: A 256/16 grid has 16 by 16 = 256 patches. VisionFrontEnd builds a fresh sinusoidal table for that grid and prepends one CLS position, giving 257 tokens.
